setup: A fraction is divided by a unit fraction.

steps.say: The dividend is [[a]]/[[b]] and the divisor has numerator 1 over [[c]].
Dividing by 1/[[c]] is the same as multiplying by [[c]], so the count of parts grows.
The result is written over [[b]] and then reduced by any common factor.

answer: So the value asked for is [[answer]].
